name: Exmouth Town Hall
summary: Council chamber and committee rooms in the heart of town.
description: For something more formal, Exmouth Town Council hires out the Council Chamber and Committee Room at the Town Hall, along with a couple of smaller meeting and interview rooms. Booking includes use of a kitchenette for tea and coffee — a straightforward option for AGMs, training sessions or committee meetings that need a proper table and chairs rather than a party atmosphere.
